description: Marauder system and radio toolkit for Cardputer Zero

store.summary: System diagnostics and radio toolkit for Cardputer Zero
store.description: A native C++ and LVGL Marauder port for Cardputer Zero. The current milestone adds the classic black and multicolor Marauder menu, FN-free WASD/Enter navigation, read-only diagnostics, adapter selection and capability reporting, and managed-mode Wi-Fi scanning; active radio features remain hardware-gated.
